🌍 SHAKAHOLA MASSACRE: THE PAUL MACKENZIE CASE | KENYA INVESTIGATIVE DOCUMENTARY

How did a religious movement become the centre of one of Kenya's most disturbing criminal investigations? The Shakahola Forest case raises serious questions about psychological manipulation, the exploitation of vulnerable people, and failures in early intervention.

🔎 In this Samatha News investigative documentary, we examine the background of Paul Nthenge Mackenzie, his religious teachings, the movement of followers into Shakahola Forest, and the investigation that brought the tragedy to international attention.

📌 This report explores:
• The origins of Good News International Ministries
• How apocalyptic predictions influenced followers
• The investigation and the discovery of burial sites
• Questions surrounding earlier warnings and official responses
• The legal proceedings and their implications for the victims' families

⚖️ COURT UPDATE: According to the case details covered in this report, a Kenyan court delivered its verdict on October 19, 2026, finding Mackenzie and 28 co-accused guilty in connection with 191 murder counts. Sentencing was scheduled for November 6, 2026.

🧠 Beyond the courtroom, this case highlights the importance of critical thinking, safeguarding children, recognising coercive control, and holding individuals accountable for criminal conduct.

This documentary is presented for news reporting, public awareness and educational discussion. It does not seek to ridicule religious belief or exploit the suffering of victims and their families.
